threats.name: Prompt/source injection into canonical facts
threats.mitigation: SourceGate flags instruction markers; payloads are read as data only; compiler emits candidates, never executes source text.

threats.name: Unapproved/rights-denied source reaches canonical state
threats.mitigation: SourceGate.decide/require_compile blocks non-E3/rights-denied sources before compilation.

threats.name: Private knowledge/projection leakage
threats.mitigation: Server-composed projections filter beliefs/memories/sealed payloads/restricted places by actor; debug requires admin.

threats.name: Unauthorized media/voice/face generation (digital human)
threats.mitigation: DigitalHumanGateway.require_permission rejects missing permission with GatewayRightsDenied; outputs are proposals.

threats.name: Secrets/privacy leaked into logs, config or backups
threats.mitigation: Settings public dict redacts secret-named values; log pipeline redacts known secrets; architecture secret scan is clean.

threats.name: Audit/history tampering or deletion
threats.mitigation: Audit records append-only (no mutation/clear API); event history append-only; corrections via new events/branches.

threats.name: Conflicting claims silently resolved without provenance
threats.mitigation: Ledger keeps claims with source_refs; promotions require review; no silent overwrite.

threats.name: Authn/authz bypass through transport
threats.mitigation: Thin FastAPI routes call application use-cases; debug/private access is server-enforced; rights checks never UI-only.
